name: Mei Lin
bio:
Mei Lin's journey into motorsport began with a fascination for the intricate mechanics of racing cars. Growing up in Shanghai, she spent countless hours tinkering with engines and learning the fundamentals of automotive engineering. After graduating from the Shanghai University of Engineering Science, she joined a local racing team as a junior mechanic, quickly proving her aptitude for fabrication and problem-solving. 

Her approach to fabrication is meticulous and detail-oriented. Mei believes that every component, no matter how small, plays a crucial role in a car's performance and reliability. She is known for her ability to adapt to changing conditions and to find innovative solutions to complex engineering challenges. What distinguishes Mei is her ability to seamlessly integrate traditional fabrication techniques with cutting-edge technologies, making her a valuable asset to any motorsport team.

physical.hairStyle: Long, straight hair often tied back in a practical ponytail.
physical.description: Mei has a focused look with high cheekbones and a determined expression.

quirks: Always carries a small notebook filled with technical sketches and ideas.
Has a collection of miniature wrenches and tools displayed on her workbench.
Prefers to work in complete silence, finding noise distracting.
